```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
housingdata <- read_csv("Downloads/global_house_purchase_dataset.csv")
View(housingdata)
```



```{r}
colSums(is.na(housingdata))
str(housingdata)
summary(housingdata)
```

```{r}
library(dplyr); library(tidyr); library(ggplot2)

df <- housingdata %>%
  mutate(
    neighbourhood_rating = as.numeric(as.character(neighbourhood_rating)),
    satisfaction_score   = as.numeric(as.character(satisfaction_score))
  )

plot_df <- df %>%
  filter(!is.na(neighbourhood_rating), !is.na(satisfaction_score)) %>%
  group_by(neighbourhood_rating) %>%
  summarise(avg_satisfaction = mean(satisfaction_score), .groups="drop") %>%
  complete(neighbourhood_rating = 1:10)   # show 1–10 on the x-axis

ggplot(plot_df, aes(neighbourhood_rating, avg_satisfaction)) +
  geom_line(color="blue") +
  geom_point() +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks=1:10, limits=c(1,10)) +
  labs(x="Neighborhood Rating (1–10)", y="Average Satisfaction")


```



```{r}

library(dplyr)
library(vcd)

data <- housingdata %>%
  mutate(
    neighborhood_category = cut(neighbourhood_rating, 
                                 breaks = c(0, 3, 6, 10),
                                 labels = c("Low (1-3)", "Medium (4-6)", "High (7-10)"),
                                 include.lowest = TRUE),
    satisfaction_category = cut(satisfaction_score,
                               breaks = c(0, 3, 6, 10),
                               labels = c("Low (1-3)", "Medium (4-6)", "High (7-10)"),
                               include.lowest = TRUE)
  )


contingency_table <- table(data$neighborhood_category, data$satisfaction_category)
print(contingency_table)


mosaicplot(contingency_table,
           main = "Relationship between Neighborhood Rating and Satisfaction Score",
           xlab = "Neighborhood Rating Category",
           ylab = "Satisfaction Score Category",
           color = c("#edf8fb", "#b2e2e2", "#66c2a4", "#238b45"),
           las = 1,)

```











```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

df <- housingdata %>%
  mutate(
    property_type = as.factor(property_type)
  )

bertin_df <- df %>%
  group_by(property_type) %>%
  summarise(
    avg_neighborhood = mean(neighbourhood_rating, na.rm = TRUE),
    avg_connectivity  = mean(connectivity_score, na.rm = TRUE),
    avg_satisfaction  = mean(satisfaction_score, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

bertin_melt <- bertin_df %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with("avg_"),
    names_to = "Metric",
    values_to = "Average"
  )

ggplot(bertin_melt, aes(x = Metric, y = property_type, fill = Average)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white") +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "white", high = "darkblue") +
  labs(
    title = "Average Lifestyle Metrics by Property Type",
    x = "Metric",
    y = "Property Type",
    fill = "Average Value"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

```


```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)

#Group by property type
bertin_raw <- housingdata %>%
  group_by(property_type) %>%
  summarise(
    avg_neighbourhood = mean(neighbourhood_rating, na.rm = TRUE),
    avg_connectivity  = mean(connectivity_score,  na.rm = TRUE),
    avg_satisfaction  = mean(satisfaction_score,  na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

#Pivot and change
bertin_long <- bertin_raw %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with("avg_"),
    names_to  = "Metric",
    values_to = "Average"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Metric = recode(
      Metric,
      "avg_neighbourhood" = "Neighborhood Rating",
      "avg_connectivity"  = "Connectivity",
      "avg_satisfaction"  = "Satisfaction"
    )
  ) %>%
  group_by(Metric) %>%
  mutate(
    z_value = (Average - mean(Average)) / sd(Average)
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

# Heatmap
ggplot(bertin_long, aes(x = Metric, y = property_type, fill = z_value)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white") +
  geom_text(aes(label = round(Average, 2)), size = 3) +
  scale_fill_gradient2(
    low = "#4575b4", mid = "white", high = "#d73027",
    midpoint = 0,
    name = "Stdev."
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Average Lifestyle Metrics by Property Type",
    x = "Metric",
    y = "Property Type"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)

# 1. Summarise by property type *and* country
bertin_raw <- housingdata %>%
  group_by(country, property_type) %>%
  summarise(
    avg_neighbourhood = mean(neighbourhood_rating, na.rm = TRUE),
    avg_connectivity  = mean(connectivity_score,  na.rm = TRUE),
    avg_satisfaction  = mean(satisfaction_score,  na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# 2. Pivot longer
bertin_long <- bertin_raw %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with("avg_"),
    names_to  = "Metric",
    values_to = "Average"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Metric = recode(
      Metric,
      "avg_neighbourhood" = "Neighborhood Rating",
      "avg_connectivity"  = "Connectivity",
      "avg_satisfaction"  = "Satisfaction"
    )
  )

# 3. Faceted Bertin-style heatmap
ggplot(bertin_long, aes(x = Metric, y = property_type, fill = Average)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white") +
  geom_text(aes(label = round(Average, 2)), size = 2.8) +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "white", high = "#4575b4", name = "Average") +
  labs(
    title = "Average Lifestyle Metrics by Property Type and Country",
    x = "Metric",
    y = "Property Type"
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~ country) +
  theme_minimal()

```
```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)

# 1. Summarise by country
bertin_country_raw <- housingdata %>%
  group_by(country) %>%
  summarise(
    avg_neighbourhood = mean(neighbourhood_rating, na.rm = TRUE),
    avg_connectivity  = mean(connectivity_score,  na.rm = TRUE),
    avg_satisfaction  = mean(satisfaction_score,  na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# 2. Pivot longer for plotting
bertin_country_long <- bertin_country_raw %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with("avg_"),
    names_to  = "Metric",
    values_to = "Average"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Metric = recode(
      Metric,
      "avg_neighbourhood" = "Neighborhood Rating",
      "avg_connectivity"  = "Connectivity",
      "avg_satisfaction"  = "Satisfaction"
    )
  )

# 3. Plot heatmap by country
ggplot(bertin_country_long, aes(x = Metric, y = country, fill = Average)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white") +
  geom_text(aes(label = round(Average, 2)), size = 3) +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "white", high = "#4575b4", name = "Average") +
  labs(
    title = "Average Neighborhood, Connectivity, and Satisfaction by Country",
    x = "Metric",
    y = "Country"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

```
